name: serverpath
description: ServerPath - a self-paced learning website about running Linux servers. React/Vite web client + Express API.

scripts.check: node scripts/validate-content.js && node scripts/smoke-test.js && node scripts/render-test.js
scripts.start:prod: npm run build:client && npm run start:api
scripts.render-build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
